doc: One row per class ability, used with the ability key (V). effect picks the behaviour: invuln = no damage taken; surge = movement multiplied (speedMul, jumpMul); turret = shoulder gun hits the nearest enemy (damage per shot, every interval s, within range units); restore = health and armour refilled; dash = short huge speed burst; slowmo = game time scaled to speedMul; damageBuff = damage dealt multiplied by power. duration and cooldown are seconds. voiceEvent is the Space Marine 2 voice line said on use; sfx names a row in sfx.json; text is the one-line description shown in the class picker.

rows.name: Iron Halo
rows.text: an energy field makes you untouchable for 5 seconds

rows.name: Jump Pack Surge
rows.text: run faster and leap far higher for 4 seconds

rows.name: Servo Turret
rows.text: your shoulder gun fires at the nearest enemy for 8 seconds

rows.name: Auspex Scan
rows.text: mark your foes: deal much more damage for 8 seconds

rows.name: Bulwark Banner
rows.text: plant the banner: health and armour fully restored

rows.name: Camo Cloak
rows.text: time slows to a crawl around you for 4 seconds
